meta.note: 由 v8 硬编码引导重构而来。所有 skill 必须数据无关：不得出现具体列名/列值/领域术语。需要具体列名时用 {placeholder} 占位符，运行时由 SkillPackage.render() 从实际 schema 填充。

skills.trigger: question concerns TREND / GROWTH / CHANGE OVER TIME
skills.action: Do not test it only on the overall total. Also decompose the trend by the primary categorical columns of this dataset ({categorical_columns}) and report per-group trends. A trend may appear in ONE subgroup while being absent overall, or vice versa.
skills.rationale: An aggregate trend can mask or invert subgroup-level behaviour.
skills.provenance: v8 _ANALYTICAL_GUIDANCE (trend clause); fixed flag-4 GT4 (0.1->1.0), flag-6 GT2 (0.3->1.0)
skills.purity: generalized — column names come from runtime schema via {categorical_columns}, none hardcoded

validated.note: v8 前后对比确认为判官无关的真实覆盖修复；on/off delta 待 mini-eval 补测

skills.trigger: question concerns an IMBALANCE / DISTRIBUTION / CONCENTRATION
skills.action: Check whether it holds uniformly across time and across the categorical groups of this dataset ({categorical_columns}), or whether it concentrates in one subgroup or one period. Report both the overall result and any notable per-group deviation; do not stop at the aggregate.
skills.rationale: A distribution stated only in aggregate hides where the imbalance actually lives.
skills.purity: generalized — column names from runtime schema

skills.trigger: aggregating or testing a trend over a time column
skills.action: Choose an aggregation granularity that leaves enough observations per bucket to be meaningful. Consult the per-column time range and bucket counts provided in the schema context before picking a granularity; do not test trends on a granularity so fine that most buckets are near-empty.
skills.rationale: Trend tests on sparse buckets produce noise rather than signal.
skills.purity: clean — purely structural, references no dataset content

validated.note: 已随 v8 温启用，未单独 ablate

skills.trigger: self-evaluating whether the findings so far answer the research goal
skills.action: For any quantity, trend, or comparison the goal asks about, check whether it has been examined ACROSS each analytical dimension available in this dataset — over time, and broken down by each of its categorical dimensions ({categorical_columns}) — NOT just as a single overall number. An overall trend or imbalance may exist in ONE subgroup while being absent or reversed in others; 'X overall' is NOT the same as 'X for every subgroup'. Any (entity x dimension) slice left unexamined is a missing aspect.
skills.rationale: Coverage failures are dominated by unexamined entity-by-dimension slices, not by missing headline numbers.
skills.purity: generalized — v8 原文硬编码了 'time, category, agent/owner, priority/group' 四个 ServiceNow 维度名，现改为从 runtime schema 注入

skills.trigger: about to declare the research goal sufficiently answered
skills.action: Before setting sufficient=true, actively try to name at least two analytical slices (entity x dimension — e.g. a metric per categorical group, a metric per group over time) that have NOT yet been examined. If you can name ANY goal-relevant unexamined slice, set sufficient=false and put those slices in missing_aspects. Set sufficient=true ONLY if you genuinely cannot think of any unexamined goal-relevant slice. If unsure, set false.
skills.rationale: The self-evaluator's default failure mode is stopping too early, not too late.
skills.purity: generalized — v8 原文举例含 ITSM 专有术语 'TTR per agent over time'，已改为通用措辞

skills.trigger: planning the next layer of questions after a previous layer has run
skills.action: Review which previously asked questions produced substantive findings and which returned nothing usable (execution errors, empty result sets, or results too sparse to interpret). Do not re-ask questions along a line of inquiry that already came back empty; redirect that effort toward slices that have not been probed yet.
skills.rationale: Without outcome feedback the planner re-spends budget on lines of inquiry already known to be dead.
skills.provenance: new in v9 — 档2 轨迹反馈（导师的经验回放方向，run 内层级）
skills.purity: clean — refers to execution outcomes, not dataset content
